{{Top|canon=Qek ship}}
The term '''Q-Ship''' referred to any [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that, while ordinarily belonging to a class of [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] or [[Transport/Legends|transport]], had been outfitted with military-grade weapon systems, [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], and armor plating. Ships that had been modified thusly were intended to pose as ordinary cargo vessels in order to lure [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] into firing range, whereupon the crew would engage the unsuspecting raiders.

==History==
The [[Gozanti-class cruiser/Legends|Gozanti Cruiser]] ''[[Krayt's Honor/Legends|Krayt's Honor]]'' was a Q-Ship that served to protect legitimate merchant vessels from attack. Many [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]] were also converted to Q-Ship status, being armed with military-grade weaponry.

==Behind the scenes==
The [[WIkipedia:Q-ship|Q-ship]] was a British naval tactic which was developed in WW1, the Germans were raiding British shipping and by 1915 Britain was desperate to find a way to beat the raiders, they come with the idea of arming a freighter with hidden weapons which could be hidden until needed, making the ship look like any other unarmed merchant ship. When a raider appeared (German submarines usually attacked convoys with their deck gun, to save precious torpedoes) the Q-ship could bring out its weaponry and sink the raider, these ships were also used by the US Navy. Q-ships later served in WW2 against German and Japanese submarines, some say they could also be used to combat modern-day pirates.
